boundary: Eligibility rules for algorithm-similarity evaluation only. Excluded rows stay in catalog.v1 with every matching reason code; no record is deleted.
matching: Tags match exactly. Contest prefixes and IDs are compared case-insensitively against the contest parsed from the stored URL (AtCoder) or key (Codeforces). Titles are compared after NFKC + casefold + whitespace collapse.

rules.rationale: SQL, shell and threading exercises are outside algorithm-concept similarity.
Codeforces' own tag for non-standard problems (April Fools, language-restricted or unusual rounds). Uses source metadata instead of a hand-written contest list.
APG4b is a programming tutorial; its entries are lessons, not algorithm problems.
Site-onboarding practice contest. 'practice2' (AtCoder Library Practice) is algorithmic and intentionally kept.
AtCoder Heuristic Contest optimisation tasks have no exact-answer algorithm concept.
Visualizer pages attached to heuristic contests are not problems.

known_gaps: Other AtCoder heuristic/marathon contests (for example future-contest qualifiers) are not identified without contest metadata; they remain eligible and must be reported as a limitation.
Codeforces problems lacking the *special tag but from unusual rounds remain eligible.

encoder_flags.non_latin_title: Title contains Cyrillic, kana, CJK or Hangul characters. Not an exclusion; MiniLM (English) runs skip flagged rows (decision D3).
